gloss: largest-class; of the highest degree; superlative

definitions.gloss: largest-class, maximum-scale, of the highest degree
definitions.explanation: Describes something that belongs to the very largest or most extreme category. Often used with の as a modifier to emphasize the superlative scale of something.

examples.japanese: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{台風|たいふう}が{接近|せっきん}している。
examples.english: A typhoon of the largest scale is approaching.

examples.japanese: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{賛辞|さんじ}を{贈|おく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to offer the highest praise.

examples.japanese: この{地震|じしん}は{観測史上|かんそくしじょう}{最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{揺|ゆ}れを{記録|きろく}した。
examples.english: This earthquake recorded shaking of the largest magnitude ever observed.

notes:
A compound of {最大|さいだい} (largest, maximum) and {級|きゅう} (class, grade, level). The suffix {級|きゅう} adds the meaning "of that class/rank," making the word function as a superlative intensifier.

USAGE:
Typically used as a modifier with の: {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{台風|たいふう} (a typhoon of the largest class). Very common in news reports and formal descriptions. The pattern 〜{級|きゅう} is productive: {世界最大級|せかいさいだいきゅう} (of the world's largest class).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{台風|たいふう}: a typhoon of the largest scale
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{賛辞|さんじ}: the highest praise
- {最大級|さいだいきゅう}の{警戒|けいかい}: the highest level of caution
- {世界最大級|せかいさいだいきゅう}: one of the largest in the world
- {史上最大級|しじょうさいだいきゅう}: one of the largest in history

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {最大|さいだい}: largest, maximum — the absolute superlative, without the "class" nuance
- {大規模|だいきぼ}な: large-scale — describes the size of an event or operation
- {過去最大|かこさいだい}: the largest ever — specifically referring to historical records
